kill_tests.hypothesis_attacked: KT1 (Analyticity & Chiral Gap): Exact opposite-chirality selection (1 - s_1*s_2) preserves Im Pi_discrete(Omega) == 0 identically for all |Omega| < 26 and recovers exact M_{S^3}(2)=6 on round S^3.
kill_tests.notes: Exact C_R(j)=(2j-1)(2j+3)/[5(2j+1)] proved analytically via stretched Wigner 6j-symbol and verified via Racah CG (8.88e-16) and SU(2) curl-matrix diagonalization (8.88e-16); max |Im K_I*| below 26 is 0.0; lowest S^3 pole E=6, S^3/I* pole E=26; same-chirality j=0 (E=4) has |O|^2=1.0000 killed strictly by (1-s1*s2)=0.

kill_tests.hypothesis_attacked: KT2 (Continuum & Weyl-Anomaly UV Recovery): High-frequency average of the discrete S^3/I* spectral density recovers the exact 4D conformal Weyl-anomaly coefficient c_anom = 9/31 (and continuum-log slope) as Omega -> infinity.
kill_tests.notes: Sliding-window period-30 dissipative spectral density (rho = 2*Im chi_R) average converges O(1/E^2) to exact 1/(40*pi)*B_2(Om) (Im Pi_micro = -Im chi_R = -N_v/(80*pi)*B_2 -> c_anom=9/31, rel err 9.77e-06 at E~6060); Euclidean K_I*(i*OmE)-ln(OmE^2/mu^2) = +724/(3*OmE^2) (rel err 1.92e-06 at OmE=5000); Gaussian heat-kernel exp(-(eps*E)^2) confirms exact cancellation of O(OmE^4 ln OmE) and O(OmE^2) local UV counterterms.

kill_tests.hypothesis_attacked: KT4 (Dynamical Volterra vs Discrete-Pole Sidebands): Run unreduced dynamical evolution on P05 x_ring and x_b=15 across Regime IV beta_0 in [0.44, 6.37] to test whether discrete 2-photon poles above Omega=26 destabilize any narrow sub-window via scalaron sidebands (Omega_grav + k*omega_scal).
kill_tests.notes: Adiabatic discrete pinch-off envelope rises to 0.7266 on x_ring (vs 0.4206 cont) and 1.1273 on x_b=15 (vs 0.7326 cont). On x_ring, beta_0 in [0.44, 0.72] is destabilized by UHP Horowitz pole repulsion (b0=0.50: gam=+2.2202e-01 H_S; Volterra Richardson diff static=2.71e-05, dyn=2.51e-05; static mp40 err J30=2.52e-05, J60=2.19e-04). domain_of_validity.regime: 1-loop conformally coupled Maxwell fields (large-N_v dominance) on R_eta x S^3/I* with homogeneous n=2 (-) TT graviton perturbation on P05 Starobinsky-Casimir KAM background.
caveats: Model A (primary, beta_pinch=0.6838) is strictly the conformal-Weyl-factored discrete kernel B_2(Om)*K_disc(Om), not the complete 1-loop Maxwell self-energy on R x S^3/I*. In the un-factored Kubo <T_ij T_kl> bubble (Model B), exact polynomial division B_2(E_j)/(E_j^2-Om^2) = (E_j^2-20) + Om^2 + B_2(Om)/(E_j^2-Om^2) generates O(1)-relative-to-Einstein-Hilbert non-Weyl topological Casimir terms on P05's Casimir-supported ring (x_ring^2 = 480.34 ~ |kappa_V| = 481.05): (a) a topology-dependent kinetic shift -2*c_anom*(zeta_{I*}(1)-zeta_{S^3}(1))*Om^2 = +125.81*Om^2 (26.2% of x_ring^2; absolute -2*c_anom*zeta_{I*}(1)*Om^2 = +140.13*Om^2 = 29.2%) that cannot be absorbed by local UV counterterms or metric-derivative-free contact diagrams, shifting static beta_pinch to 0.5615-0.5747; and (b) a Kubo Om^0 constant -2*c_anom*(zeta_{I*}(3)-20*zeta_{I*}(1)) = +608048/155 = +3922.89 (102% of 8*x_ring^2 = 3842.75) that combines with the uncomputed squashed-Bianchi-IX contact/tadpole diagram to form the O(1)-relative-to-curvature static Casimir shear modulus.

Time-domain dynamical runs use exact discrete harmonic oscillators for all nonzero S^3/I* poles j <= J_cut (J_cut=30, 15 poles E<=122; verified at J_cut=60, 45 poles E<=242 with 2.32e-4 trajectory diff at beta_0=1.0) K0-matched to a smooth continuum-log UV tail above M_tail = 4*J_cut+4; KT4 production BDF (rtol=1e-8, max_step=0.025) conserves exact H_tot to 3.38e-8 over eta=35 and matches tight-tolerance Radau (rtol=1e-10, max_step=0.01, Nu=64) to |d_gamma| <= 2.91e-6 H_S across beta_0 in {0.747, 1.00, 1.719}.

KT4 tests 34 beta_0 values on x_ring (including exact dressed hyperbolic Krein candidates H1=0.747, H_fund=1.199, H2_mod=1.217, H3=1.994, H4=2.186) over tau = 773.4 H_S^-1 (5.65 T_macro) and 12 beta_0 values on x_b=15 over tau = 707.5 H_S^-1; macro-modulation of Om_scal in [38.60, 43.47] chirps across E_10=42 and suppresses locking, though ultra-narrow tongues (Delta_beta_0 << 0.01) or secular growth below gamma ~ 1e-4 H_S beyond tau = 773 are not excluded.

Large-N_v Maxwell closure omits O(1/N_v) 2-graviton self-loops (cut at 2*sqrt(8)~5.66 < 26) and nonlinear radiation/scalaron backreaction into Friedmann E_00=0 (CLM-OPEN-02); P05's sigma_0=9/31 background sits at 4*c_anom*omega_scal^2 = 4.000 (strict 1-loop scalaron EFT requires sigma_t >= 4).
